evaluation_error: R06 cannot be fully evaluated: delivered PNG signature, decoded dimensions, and file metadata are not supplied. Saved render resolution alone does not establish delivered image dimensions.

rubric_scores.evidence: The shell contains a floor, ceiling, rear wall and only one returning wall. The rear-right inset is a plain box without the required vertical pattern. Instrument arrays and horizontal grille louvers are present.

Both separate consoles have inclined faces and writing ledges at plausible relative heights. However, principal-console instruments are plain single-material blocks without light faces and dark bezels; the smaller console contains only repeated cylindrical controls. Required console finishes and instrumentation are incomplete.

A wall-mounted yellow board, black trunk and branches, red circular lamps and amber squares exist. Selector dials are blank plates with cylindrical knobs, lacking tick-mark scales. The diagram has disconnected short segments and does not reproduce the reference's grouped branch structures.

Ceiling panel geometry and overhead lights accompany a muted cream-gray palette. Nevertheless, the authored presentation reads as a clean, simplified blockout with uniform surfaces rather than the required subtly aged institutional interior.

Two distinct cameras exist, and the overview axis points modestly downward. The supplied authored view crops the principal console and omits the GRID board; no authored close-up establishes the required combined readability.

The authored image depicts the reconstruction, but delivered-file PNG validation and dimensions are unavailable. The saved resolution is only 374×512, which does not independently verify the delivered file.
The project opens and contains editable meshes and two cameras, but the saved view transform is AgX instead of the explicitly required Filmic.

dimension_scores.evidence: The long console, rear meter banks, grille and smaller right console establish the intended scene, but equipment detail and architectural enclosure are simplified.
Pedestals meet the floor, but side views show substantial unsupported gaps beneath the inclined console slabs and writing ledges.
Neutral cream-gray surfaces and the yellow board suit the requested palette. Repetitive blank controls and simplified meter faces weaken period-specific shapes.
Uniform primitive geometry, blank instrument faces and visible render grain make the room read as an unfinished model.
The rear instrument wall, intervening grille, foreground long console and back-right smaller console retain the main spatial relationships. The shell remains incomplete.
Console heights, slopes, control sizes and the size difference between consoles are broadly plausible. Large empty wall and ceiling areas dilute the reference's equipment density.
Broad soft lighting keeps equipment visible and matte surfaces are appropriate, but pale exposure, weak material differentiation and grain reduce clarity.
All major equipment categories are visible across views. Missing enclosure walls, vertical inset pattern, detailed console instruments and selector scales leave substantial required work incomplete.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
